rows.note: Use this as the everyday all-purpose choice when “partly” means to some degree or somewhat.

example.jyutping: ngo5 jau5 di1 ming4 baak6 laa3

rows.note: Use this with an action or result to say that it is not fully completed.

example.english: I have only partly watched the movie.
example.jyutping: bou6 hei3 ngo5 mei6 tai2 saai3

rows.note: Use this when a divisible task, object, or amount has been dealt with only in part.

example.jyutping: ngo5 dei6 zou6 zo2 jat1 bou6 fan6 gung1 fo3

rows.note: Use this for an abstract or carefully worded statement meaning “to some extent.”

example.traditional: 某程度上，呢個決定係合理嘅。
example.jyutping: mau5 cing4 dou6 soeng6 ni1 go3 kyut3 ding6 hai6 hap6 lei5 ge3
